key_insight: Func-JEPA learns reusable latent representations of symbolic functions whose geometry imitates the Sobolev space H¹, with differentiation learned as a latent operator.
engineering_relevance: A shared, frozen function encoder could reduce the need to train separate end-to-end models for symbolic mathematics tasks.
method: Pretrain an encoder on symbolic functions.
Compute latent norms exactly from functions and learn directions to match Sobolev angles.
Reuse the frozen encoder with lightweight modules for decoding, composition, integration, and regression from samples.
evidence_signal: Evaluated within and outside the pretraining distribution, f-JEPA recovers exact formulas from noisy samples more often than compared symbolic-regression methods, but trails computer algebra and task-specific models on standard integration and differential-equation benchmarks.
watch_item: The shared representation does not yet replace specialized solvers across symbolic mathematics tasks.
paper_title: Func-JEPA: Learning a Sobolev Space of Functions as Latent Vectors
